$comment: REQ-EQP-007: legendary equipment changes how a build WORKS. None of these is a large multiplier — each one makes a build possible that was not possible before, or imposes a cost that reshapes how the hunter must be played.

effects.name: The Long Argument
effects.description: Every consecutive attack against the same target hits harder; switching targets resets it. Rewards the target-lock the AI already keeps (REQ-AI-006).

effects.name: The Widow's Ledger
effects.description: Healing done to a downed ally is doubled; healing to a healthy one is halved. A healer built around this is useless at attrition and irreplaceable at disasters.

effects.name: The Iron Promise
effects.description: The bearer cannot be reduced below one health while an ally is downed. Turns a tank into a hard guarantee, at the cost of everything offensive.

effects.name: Cold Arithmetic
effects.description: Skills cost nothing below a quarter resource, but the bearer regenerates none. Converts a sustained build into a series of committed pushes.
